prayerExcerpt.en-US: Almighty God, to serve you is to reign.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus todo-poderoso, a quem servir é reinar.

meta.face: A pale, slender young prince of about twenty-four (a young man, not a boy), clean-shaven, with a LONG, NARROW face — a high, smooth forehead, a long, straight, slender nose with a slightly drooping tip, heavy-lidded grey-green eyes under fine, high-arched light-brown brows, long, smooth cheeks with faint colour, a small, gently curved closed mouth and a narrow, rounded chin; straight chestnut-brown hair parted in the middle and falling to the shoulders; a gentle, recollected gaze to one side.
meta.basis: The painting of 1594 (Wikipedia lead), which follows the Vilnius 'three-handed' image, shows a long, pale face with a long nose, heavy lids and shoulder-length brown hair under a red crowned cap, in an ermine-lined red robe with lilies. The card follows it; he died of tuberculosis at twenty-five.
